# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:** Know that before states of spiritual obscurity and states of spiritual illumination had been distinguished within the mind, the Divine mediating power of separation was summoned forth from the Divine itself . And afterward it was sent into the condition of utter spiritual emptiness — the external mind wholly devoid of truth and good — so that it might lib erate wisdom from its entanglement with falsity, and divide the state of ignorance from the state of understanding , each from the other.

**¶3 :** Before wisdom had been released from capt ivity among falsities , and freed , and had ascended through the successive degrees of the mind, the Divine as the source of all spiritual life prepared for it doctrinal vessels — containing forms of truth, beau tifully ordered . These were fashioned so that wisdom might be purified within them, and be brought into distinct and well -ordered form, as one shapes understanding into its proper arrangement .

**¶4:** Before evil had multiplied and established its dominion in the sensual and natural life of the person — before those governed by good and those governed by evil had been set apart from one another — the principle of Divine disc ernment was sent forth and made manifest . Its seat of authority was established within the living spiritual sphere, so that it would function as the power of just discrimination , and so that there those in states of charity and those in states of self-love would be examined , tested , and separated each from the other.

**¶ 6:** Again , before the spiritual life of hum ankind had been brought into being, some were designated as those possessing kn owledges of good and truth, and others as those lacking them. Before they undergo spiritual death, those dest ined for the cess ation of interior life are marked out by their interior qualities of understanding and by the spiritual dispositions inher ent in the order of their origin . These qualities are appointed for them; within them lie the begin nings of their spiritual life. And their inmost ruling love is bound to their spiritual character from the very root ; and they are led by these interior states and brought to an im partial evaluation in accordance with their actual loves and their ev ils.

*( Note: The " stars and signs of the zodiac in the sphere" resist simple one -to-one translation. They correspond most closely to fixed interior spiritual dispos itions — qualities of understanding and will determined from one 's spiritual origin — functioning as a kind of spiritual hered ity that inc lines but ultimately answers to judgment by de eds. The a strological image enc odes what Swedenborg calls the ruling love as it is from one 's earliest spiritual formation .)*

**¶7:** Again, before the present state of the church reaches its cons ummation and all its external form is dissolved, the powers of dissolution were already appointed and prepared for that dismantling.

** ¶8:** And before the new spiritual dispens ation — the new heaven and the new church — had been established and brought into beauty and full ness of order, the Divine operating through creative wisdom was summoned forth : the primary ordering principle, together with all the active divine truths that serve it, who would build and bring into beauty the new state of spiritual life.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Know that before night and day were differentiated in the universe, the Third [Am]bassador was summoned. And afterwards, he was sent to this void and outer waste that he might purify the light, and separate night and day from each other.

Before the light was released and freed and ascended through this zone, the Father of Life made beautiful for it the ships of light. He constructed them so that it might be purified in them, and be sculpted and fashioned in good order.

[Bef]ore Sin had multiplied and had made a kingdom in the flesh, before the acquitted and the condemn[ed] were set apart from each other, the Judge [w]as sent forth and revealed. His throne was created and placed [i]n the living atmosphere, so that he would be a just Judge, so that there the righteous and the sinners would be set apart and tested and separated from each other.

Again, [befo]re mankind had been engendered, some were named ['rich' and] others 'poor' on earth [and their portion was decreed] upon them. Before they die, they who will die are marked out by the stars and the signs of the zodiac in the sphere. They are appointed for them; in them are their births. And their root is bound up with their zodiacal signs; and they are compelled by them and brought to an equal judgement in accordance with their deeds and their sins.
Again, before the universe is dissolved, [and the] entire earth, the destroyers were appointed and instructed for its dissolution.

And before the ne[w] aeon was [built and] made be[auti]ful and marked out, [the] Great Builder [w]as summoned, the first architect and the angels who are with him, who would build and make beautiful the new aeon.
Also, before the error and offence of the sects were displayed in the universe, the blessed Christ was ordained and brought forth
